title: Any free image/text to AI mesh generators (not credits based)
author: Brand_Sub8486
selftext: Is there any free tool anymore which generates meshes from images or text using AI? I used Sparc 3D earlier, it was pretty damn good but seems it has become paid now.

comments.author: Rizzlord
comments.body: you wont find something like this, because its incredible tech, unless you use your own pc to generate. Then you have to go through the hassle of installing and make it work. you need at least 12gb vram.

replies.author: Brand_Sub8486
replies.body: Is there any software which can generate meshes using my own pc? Goes without saying that like all game devs I also have a good graphics card.
